{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Mahogany''' was a material. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a grand staircase in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was fitted with mahogany railings.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] supported [[Gender/Legends|herself]] on a mahogany railing on the staircase after experiencing a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]].<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mahogany appeared in the [[1996]] [[Bantam Spectra]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
